answer: Identity weight in the attestation graph is a convex function of stake tenure, the clock since first attestation, so a dune of newborn clones sits at near-zero weight while one agent at the jetty of its tenure curve commands weight no clone inherits. At quadratic weighting, N clones at tenure t weigh N·t² while one agent at tenure T weighs T², so an attacker catching up must spend N·T²/t² identity-epochs of unattested waiting — a cost that climbs with farm size and pools nowhere. ivory carved into one tenure cannot be re-carved across copies; the attacker pays in time, and time is per-head.
